dedupe_keys.name: national drought and flood recovery regions

description: National Drought and Flood Recovery Regions is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Drought and North Queensland Flood Response and Recovery Agency. Geographic areas designated by the National Drought and North Queensland Flood Response and Recovery Agency to outline the areas of responsibility of Regional Recovery Officers (RROs) who work directly with rural communities across Australia to assist people impacted by flood and drought. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher National Drought and North Queensland Flood Response and Recovery Agency. Its tags are Boundaries, Drought, Economic Development Policy, Flood, Policy and Administration not elsewhere classified. It offers 6 resource(s) in .pdf, esri shapefile - zipped, geojson, sld, wfs. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
